_comment: UPDATED 2026-09-30 (v3) -- 'samplesheet' REMOVED from this file entirely. Root cause of every prior samplesheet 404, found by reading the actual cirro Python SDK source (cirro/helpers/preprocess_dataset.py, CirroBio/Cirro-SDK-Python on GitHub -- not a guess, the literal installed code): PreprocessDataset.from_running() reads 'PW_S3_DATASET' as dataset_root, then loads files from '<dataset_root>/config/files.csv' and '<dataset_root>/config/samplesheet.csv'. Two things were wrong in every earlier version of this key: (1) the path was missing the 'config/' segment -- we pointed at '<dataset_root>/samplesheet.csv', Cirro actually stores it one level deeper; (2) hardcoding to the CRC_Sample_SPATIA_Test dataset ID (8ce58e3d-...) was unnecessary AND wrong -- Cirro auto-populates config/samplesheet.csv and config/files.csv on every new per-run dataset (that's the whole point of PreprocessDataset -- ds.samplesheet/ds.files are populated automatically from the CURRENT dataset, no hardcoded ID needed). So instead of guessing a static S3 path here at all, preprocess.py now reads ds.samplesheet + ds.files directly (both load automatically, no path needed) and calls ds.add_param('samplesheet', ...) itself to hand Nextflow the final, merged, fully-resolved file. That is the documented, intended pattern (docs.cirro.bio/pipelines/preprocess-script/: 'One of the most common tasks performed in the preprocess script is to construct a sample sheet...'). Confidence this diagnosis is correct: ~90% -- based on reading the actual installed SDK source, not inference from error text; the ~10% uncertainty is whether ds.samplesheet is reliably populated in this account's Cirro version the way the SDK docs describe, which the next run will confirm or refute.
